messages.subject: Mentors? Comments on proposals
parts:
Possibly I'm jumping the gun, but I have assigned as mentors those who said they were
willing to the projects that did not have a mentor assigned.

However, there are still some projects without mentors. Please indicate your willingness
so Claudia or I can "assign" you.

I'm not sure if no mentor by the Friday deadline means projects get dropped, but it would
be rather bad if that happened. If we decide not to approve projects that is a different
matter, but not getting them on the board to consider would be very bad.

Best, JN
